detail.longDescription: Any web page can POST to a localhost port. Datadog found OpenCode's web UI (127.0.0.1:4096, no auth by default) taking a text/plain form to /global/upgrade, which CORS does not block, and installing an attacker's npm package. Fixed in 1.18.22. https:// securitylabs.datadoghq.com/art icles/opencode-upgrade-remote-code-execution/ For a browser view of a terminal agent behind a password, with --read-only for watchers, we built https:// shell.online # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # OpenSource
